author: Simpp
quote: After waiting 13 years and paying a ridiculous $80 just to play it, GTA 6 feels like a massive letdown that relies entirely on hype rather than good game design. Locking the game at a choppy 30 FPS in 2026, even on a PS5 Pro is completely unacceptable, especially when the screen blurs out and frames tank the second anything chaotic happens. Beyond the launch bugs and falling through the map, the actual gameplay feels stuck in 2013 with the same clunky controls, repetitive bullet-sponge shootouts, and missions that fail you instantly if you take two steps off Rockstar’s strict script. Worst of all, the first twenty hours are bogged down by boring life-sim chores like moving furniture and working out, wrapped in safe, watered-down writing that completely misses the sharp satire that used to make GTA great. In conclusion, not worth it, story ****, got my refund from PlayStation :)
